campaign.name: Beat the surface code at k=25, weight-6, 2D bilayer

direction.hypothesis: A weight-6 bilayer code at k~25 can beat the holey surface baseline [[598,25,4]] on kd^2/n.
direction.feasibility: Bilayer weight-6 cell has headroom; existing BB families reach this regime.

novelty.claim: First systematic k~25 frontier probe in bilayer weight-6
novelty.against: Existing 2D-bilayer weight-6 entries and holey surface codes.

direction.expected_value: A bilayer weight-6 code at k>=20 on the cell frontier would extend multi-logical 2D results.
direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: Whether weight-6 bilayer constructions can reach k~25, or whether locality caps the cell.
